name: novelty
prompt: Novelty: how much genuinely new understanding the work contributes — a new problem, method, or finding a well-read researcher in the area would not already possess — rather than incremental variation on known work.

name: clarity
prompt: Clarity of writing: how easily a competent reader outside the immediate subfield can follow what was done and what was found — plain structure, defined terms, no padding.

name: evidence
prompt: Strength of empirical evidence: how convincingly the claims are backed — scale and breadth of experiments, baselines, ablations, reported numbers — as opposed to asserted or unquantified.
